description: Publish the current draft so respondents see it, returning the public link. If the change affects questions that already have answers, it is refused unless confirm_data_impact is true. Requires the "forms" scope.

api_key.description: Your Datronis personal access token (starts with "dtk_"). Generate one at /app/api-keys/. Required unless sent as an `Authorization: Bearer <token>` HTTP header instead (preferred — see search_jobs' api_key description for why).

confirm_data_impact.description: Set true to publish even though the change affects questions that already have answers.

form_id.description: Form id — from list_forms or create_form.

name: publish_form
